title: Maanaadu
desc: A man is pulled into a plot to assassinate a chief minister at a political rally. However, he soon realises that he is trapped in a time loop with a police officer.

title: Thavarina Theru
desc: Sridhar, an orphaned villager with a quiet heart, finds love in Shruti, but their path forward is tangled in her deep sense of duty towards her struggling family.

title: Maurya
desc: Manu, a kick-boxer must train and win an upcoming tournament to fulfill his mother's wishes and to become the best in the world.

title: Kabzaa
desc: Ravi works for Veljibhai Soda, a gangster, and does illegal work for him. Once, he is asked to vacate Ali from his property, but he gets inspired by his ideals and decides to change his ways.

title: Ayogya
desc: Siddhe Gowda, an unemployed young man, decides to run against Bachche Gowda, the village head, in the local election. He also begins to fall in love with Nandini, the daughter of a marriage broker.
